name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, runtime and log directories, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI tutorial application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment, and runs the application with systemd/Uvicorn.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, self-signed certificates, site content, firewall and SSH hardening, fail2ban, sysctl, and nginx security controls.
